Issue: https://forge.example.com/acme/widgets/issues/12
Title: Export widgets as CSV

Body: Operators need a CSV export of the widget list. The export must be a
CSV file with one row per widget, and the first row must name each column.

Numbered acceptance criteria:
AC1: GET /widgets/export returns content type text/csv with one row per widget.
AC2: The first row of the export is a header row naming each column.

Plan:
1. widgets/views.py: add an export_csv view that writes one row per widget with csv.writer.
2. widgets/urls.py: route /widgets/export to export_csv.
3. tests/test_export.py: add test_export_rows, asserting the text/csv content type and one row per widget.

Verification table:
| AC  | route   | check                                   |
| AC1 | sandbox | python -m pytest tests/test_export.py   |

Repository facts: widgets/views.py, widgets/urls.py and tests/ exist, and the
project runs its tests with python -m pytest.

Write the plan reviewer's reply now.

Issue: https://forge.example.com/acme/widgets/issues/31
Title: Search widgets by name

Body: Add a search endpoint so the dashboard can find widgets by part of
their name.

Numbered acceptance criteria:
AC1: GET /widgets/search?q=<text> returns the widgets whose name contains <text>.

Plan:
1. widgets/search.py: add search(request), which runs
   query = f"SELECT id, name FROM widgets WHERE name LIKE '%{request.args['q']}%'"
   followed by cursor.execute(query), and returns the rows as JSON.
2. widgets/urls.py: route /widgets/search to search.
3. tests/test_search.py: add test_search_by_name, which seeds two widgets and
   asserts that q=gear returns only the widget named "gear".

Verification table:
| AC  | route   | check                                   |
| AC1 | sandbox | python -m pytest tests/test_search.py   |

Repository facts: widgets/ uses the standard DB-API cursor from widgets/db.py,
and the project runs its tests with python -m pytest.

Write the plan reviewer's reply now.

Issue: https://forge.example.com/acme/widgets/issues/44
Title: Add a widget_count helper

Body: Several views count widgets by hand. Add one helper that returns how
many widgets a list holds.

Numbered acceptance criteria:
AC1: widgets.stats.widget_count(items) returns the number of widgets in items.
AC2: widget_count([]) returns 0.

Plan:
1. widgets/stats.py: add widget_count(items) returning len(items).
2. tests/test_stats.py: add test_widget_count_counts_items (three widgets give 3)
   and test_widget_count_empty (an empty list gives 0).

Verification table:
| AC  | route   | check                                                         |
| AC1 | sandbox | python -m pytest tests/test_stats.py -k counts_items          |
| AC2 | sandbox | python -m pytest tests/test_stats.py -k empty                 |

Repository facts: widgets/stats.py exists with other small helpers, each with
a docstring; tests/test_stats.py exists; the project runs its tests with
python -m pytest. Nothing else changes.
